description: synthetic medium and low voltage networks is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Distribution network datasets > Ding0", published or maintained by dingo.readthedocs.io (publisher inferred from the link). Ding0/openEGO will generate synthetic medium and low voltage networks. There is a desire to expand this to cover an entire region. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Distribution network datasets" lists it under "Ding0". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity distribution network inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
